source.map_area_convention: [left, top, right, bottom]; right and bottom exclusive; pixels of original image; x right, y down
source.geometry_convention: Clockwise outlines in y-down image coordinates, not repeated closed vertex. Roof/main structure envelopes are simplified; obscured ground footprints are approximate. height_m is roof height above local ground/platform, not absolute terrain altitude.
source.rotation_convention: rotation_deg is clockwise from image +x to the first polygon edge, modulo 180; positive y points down. It is a drafting reference edge, not necessarily the pad long axis or in-game heading.

scale.how: One shared X/Y scale for the whole source image, fitted by least squares in metres to the listed independent visible pad-side controls; uniform fallback when directional scales are not identifiable or would require excessive stretch.
scale.basis: User-confirmed classes, user working dimensions Large170x90m, Medium135x70m, Small70x50m.
limitations: A confirmed class does not identify a precise mechanical deck boundary: traced paint/apron envelopes are approximate.
One shared transform retains residuals at individual pads. Reference dimensions are not forced independently on each pad.
Reconstructed hidden edges are inferred, not additional calibration observations. Negative/out-of-image pixels are permitted only for documented reconstructions.
Camera perspective, roof parallax and terrain can cause local differences; estimates are unsuitable for survey accuracy.
No statistical confidence interval is claimed. Roof heights and floor estimates are preserved.

fingerprint.description: Large pad west and small pad south-east of seven labelled HAB complexes; central cross-shaped HAB, east rectangular HAB with two L0 terminals, and large southern multistorey HAB with symmetric upper/caret door annotations; PWR north-east. Pad classes and storey estimates are visual estimates.

details.notes: Coordinates are original-plan pixels, origin top-left, x right, y down. Footprints are clockwise orthogonal approximations, including stepped approximations of rounded ends. Every height is a low-confidence visual estimate from oblique image, not a measured elevation. hab-7 north projection is treated as part of its connected footprint; four unlabelled ancillary structures are conservatively other, not inferred storage. Paved walkway centrelines are approximate visible apron links, not surveyed routes; none confidently identified as covered or bridge. No people, ships, terrain rocks or shadows traced.

Legend symbols are metadata only and are not counted as map points. Terminal L0 and Terminal > L0 indicate terminal security/access levels, not physical storeys. Cyan Terminal > L0 style is shown in legend but no such map marker is visible. The red/blue shared legend label is printed Airlock / Inner Door. Orange top-left i is website UI and not part of printed legend.

uncertain: All outlines are pixel-space visual traces. Orthogonal stepped polygons approximate rounded or oblique roof edges; ground-level walls hidden by eaves, marker circles and shadow cannot be recovered exactly.

The map is an overhead screenshot with residual perspective and small rotations; squaring the building footprints intentionally simplifies those deviations. Source pixels remain authoritative rather than metre conversions.

Pad classes are visual estimates: west pad is labelled large and south-east pad small in this data, but S/M/L is not printed on the source. Fingerprint pad counts reflect those low-confidence choices, not verified game data.

Scale 0.4921 m/px is a low-confidence average from assumed 213x128 m large-pad dimensions over a 455x248 px painted rectangle. The 174x167 px small-pad rectangle gives inconsistent estimates from assumed 66x55 m dimensions. Odyssey apron boundaries may not correspond to nominal pad dimensions.

Ships and deep shadows obscure substantial portions of both pads; inferred rectangular extents are based on the visible painted corners and strips. Ships, circular touchdown marks and shadow silhouettes are excluded from pad geometry.

Every height_m and floors value is a low-confidence visual estimate from the oblique image, relative to each building local ground/platform. No survey, camera calibration, terrain elevation or reliable scale anchor is available.

Southern hab-7 includes the unlabelled northward projection as a connected part of the same footprint based on visible roof/platform continuity. It could contain an annex or a separate connected structure; do not treat that segmentation as verified.
Seven HAB labels and one PWR label are visible. The four unlabelled ancillary footprints are conservatively kind other; storage, command or specific utility functions are not inferred.

Walkways are low-confidence open centrelines through visible paving/apron links. Widths are approximate and their exact connectivity is uncertain; no span is confidently identified as covered or a bridge.

Blue door annotations 1^ and 1^^ and yellow alarm annotation A^^ preserve the literal caret marks; where two occur, they are stacked vertically to the right. Their exact meaning and physical storey are not established, so all point.floor values remain null.

Terminal L0 and Terminal >L0 identify security/access levels, not physical floors. Door numerals are likewise security/access levels; a numbered or unmarked icon alone cannot establish its physical storey.

Icon circles may be editorially offset from the corresponding physical object and conceal the underlying roof detail. point.at records the visible icon centre, not an independently surveyed in-game door or console coordinate.

The blue i is an editorial Tips & tricks marker with unavailable popup content. The orange i is a website control retained for completeness and should be excluded from a navigable physical settlement model.
No point has an independently verified physical storey from these two views; floor is null even when its icon shows an access number, L0, > L0 or carets.
All at coordinates are the printed annotation centres; editorial placement can be offset from the physical object. Some touching circles are individually recorded.
The orange top-left information button is retained as scope map_ui for complete icon transcription, and should not be drawn as a physical settlement object.

construction.verification: Every live Approximate Shopping List was opened and its commodity IDs/quantities captured. Sorted commodity-pair FNV-1a digest and quantity sum were independently checked against this saved record. Values are approximate, not a guaranteed project bill.

distinctive_geometry_features: Seven HABs form a compact cluster with two large branched end buildings and a central cross-like HAB.
PWR stands northeast beyond the upper large HAB; a separate rectangular HAB is on the east.
A large pad is west and a small pad southeast; ship/shadow occlusion does not change this arrangement.

previous_scale.how: Low-confidence estimate from the large pad painted landing-area rectangle: traced long edge 455 px (about [228,177] to [682,195]) and short edge 248 px (about [682,195] to [672,443]); mean of 213 m / 455 px = 0.4681 and 128 m / 248 px = 0.5161 gives 0.4921 m/px. Nominal community pad dimensions are small 66x55 m, medium 150x90 m, large 213x128 m (https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Landing_Pad); applying them to these Odyssey painted/apron boundaries is an unverified assumption. Small pad trace is about 174x167 px and implies 0.3793/0.3293 m/px, demonstrating substantial boundary/perspective uncertainty. Ships and shadows were excluded. Not suitable for precise navigation or elevation recovery.

geometry_m.superseded_note: Kept for traceability. site_m holds the plan fitted to SrvSurvey's measured positions, in SrvSurvey's site frame.

frame.origin: Settlement position from the journal (ApproachSettlement Latitude/Longitude), as SrvSurvey uses it
frame.heading: Site heading = ship heading while docked on pad 1, or ship heading minus that pad's rotation_deg on any other pad (SrvSurvey HumanSiteData).
frame.to_world: bearing = heading + atan2(x, y); east = x*cos(h) + y*sin(h); north = -x*sin(h) + y*cos(h)
frame.rotation_convention: rotation_deg and rot_deg are clockwise from +y
frame.floor_convention: SrvSurvey floors: 1 = ground floor, 2 = one floor up, 3 = two floors up. SrvSurvey also uses 0: on every combat-zone point and on a few others, where its meaning isn't documented; those are copied as given. floor_basis says where each floor came from: srvsurvey, or icon carets (the plan's ^ marks, no caret = ground floor). plan_floor keeps the plan's reading where SrvSurvey's differs.
frame.access_convention: Security level 0-3: SrvSurvey's level where matched, otherwise the plan's printed number
frame.source_convention: plan = only on the plan; srvsurvey = only in SrvSurvey; plan+srvsurvey = both, at SrvSurvey's position

site_m.pixel_to_site_note: [X, Y, W] = M . [px, py, 1]; site = (X/W, Y/W). Third row is [0, 0, 1] for a uniform fit.
